item.title: Optimizing My Symbol Layer: A Data Driven Approach
item.description: When first designing my layout on my Corne keyboard, I was mostly focused on the macro level of what layers keys should go on as well as the ease of common workflows like selecting text or switching workspaces. I put some thought into the placement of each symbol, but after growing quite comfortable with my keyboard and having a nagging feeling that something about the placement of my symbols felt off, it was finally a good opportunity to revisit the micro details of my symbols layer.
